channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: GSTHR Estimates 200 Million People Use Non-Combustible Nicotine Products as 28 Countries Show Rising Use Alongside Falling Smoking Rates
item.description: GSTHR estimates about 200 million people worldwide use what it terms “safer nicotine products,” including vapes, heated tobacco, nicotine pouches and snus. The report says use of non-combustible products rose while smoking rates fell in 28 countries analyzed. (Published on September 10, 2026by2firsts.com)

item.title: Ireland Leader "Wrong on the Science" as He Backs Vape Ban
item.description: Ireland’s Taoiseach has been accused of dangerously misleading smokers after claiming vapes are “nearly worse than cigarettes” and signalling support for an outright ban. (Published on September 10, 2026bysmokefreesweden.org)

item.title: Nicotine Pouches Versus Vaping Products
item.description: Nicotine pouches suit adults who prioritise a compact, vapour-free option with no charging or maintenance. Vaping products suit adults who value flavour range, an inhaled experience and the familiarity of a device-based routine. Many adult nicotine users may see a role for both, using a vape as their main format and pouches when vaping is not practical. (Published on September 10, 2026byvapeo.co.uk)

item.title: FDA Names Koplow as Tobacco Center Director
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has selected Bret Koplow, Ph.D., J.D., as director of the Center for Tobacco Products, giving the center a permanent leader with more than a decade of legal, policy, and regulatory experience at the agency. Koplow has served at FDA since 2011, including as senior counselor to the FDA commissioner, where he focused on regulatory, policy, and operational matters involving tobacco products. (Published on September 10, 2026bytobaccoreporter.com)

item.title: Vape Restrictions Could Cost £Billions
item.description: Government vaping restrictions could cost public health up to £4.5 billion, according to Elfbar, a leading smoking cessation brand in the UK. (Published on September 11, 2026byplanetofthevapes.co.uk)
